user_name.description: The username used for constructing default paths.

export_qt_theme.description: If true, exports the current Qt color theme settings into Wine's color configuration.

minimize_on_startup.description: If true, minimizes the Q4Wine main window immediately upon startup.

qt_theme.description: The name of the Qt color theme to apply (light, dark, or system).

default_wine_version.description: The default Wine version identifier to use for managing prefixes.

wine_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to the Wine binary.

winetricks_plugins.description: List of Winetricks plugins to execute during prefix creation or management. Each item is a flat object containing 'command' and 'enabled' fields.
